title: Service Hours Counted Against a Contracted Event
content:
The service hours the contracted staffing of a Private Event & Banquet Services event is counted over are settled by how the guaranteed count compares with the working count the booking was taken at.

## The three cases

1. Where a confirmed guarantee entry stands on the booking and the count it guarantees exceeds the working count the booking was taken at, the hours counted are the service hours included in the package together with the set-up lead hours and the tear-down window hours printed against the same package, because the room has to be re-dressed to the larger count and cleared after it.
2. Where a confirmed guarantee entry stands on the booking and the count it guarantees does not exceed the working count the booking was taken at, the hours counted are the service hours included in the package together with the tear-down window hours printed against the same package.
3. Where no confirmed guarantee entry stands on the booking, the hours counted are the service hours included in the package alone.

A guaranteed count equal to the working count the booking was taken at does not exceed it, and so falls in the second case.

## The hours each package prints

| Package | Service hours included | Set-up lead hours | Tear-down window hours | First case, hours | Second case, hours | Third case, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0.0 | 0.5 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 2.0 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 4.0 | 3.0 | 2.0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 4.0 | 2.0 | 1.5 | 7.5 | 5.5 | 4.0 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 5.0 | 4.0 | 2.0 | 11.0 | 7.0 | 5.0 |
| Gala Reception Package | 6.0 | 6.0 | 3.0 | 15.0 | 9.0 | 6.0 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 10.0 | 8.0 | 4.0 | 22.0 | 14.0 | 10.0 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A booking on the Gala Reception Package taken at a working count of 240 guests carries a confirmed guarantee entry of 260. The guaranteed count exceeds the working count, so the hours counted are 6.0 together with 6.0 and 3.0, that is 15.0. Had the guarantee been given at 240, the hours counted would be 6.0 together with 3.0, that is 9.0; and with no confirmed guarantee entry standing at all, 6.0.
